Job record stuck at COMMITTING 65% (status: committing, finishedAt: None, commitSha: '')
The commit landed on GitHub at 20:18:52Z, but the job record never advanced to COMPLETED
Root cause: The worker process crashes or hangs AFTER the GitHub commit API call succeeds but BEFORE it updates the job record to COMPLETED. The onPhase?.('committing', 'Commit created: ...') callback never fires (the stage detail is still the initial "Committing via GitHub Git Data API.")
This is a DIFFERENT bug than the original orphaning — the orphaning is fixed (proven: runtime unchanged). This is a post-commit job-record-update failure
